mkdir -p /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion && cat > /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_download_eval_pure.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1

MODELS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models"
RESULTS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion"
LOG="$RESULTS/pure_download_eval.log"

echo "=== PURE DOWNLOAD+EVAL START $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"

# ---- DOWNLOAD ----
declare -A REPOS
REPOS[GLA]="m-a-p/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline"
REPOS[DeltaNet]="m-a-p/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"
REPOS[HGRN]="m-a-p/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline"

declare -A LOCAL_DIRS
LOCAL_DIRS[GLA]="$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline"
LOCAL_DIRS[DeltaNet]="$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"
LOCAL_DIRS[HGRN]="$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline"

for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  REPO="${REPOS[$ARCH]}"
  LOCAL="${LOCAL_DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  
  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "$ARCH pure already exists at $LOCAL, skipping download" | tee -a "$LOG"
    continue
  fi
  
  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH pure from $REPO START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET']='1'
os.environ['HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER']='1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('$REPO', local_dir='$LOCAL')
print('Download OK: $REPO')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

# ---- VERIFY DOWNLOADS ----
echo "=== VERIFY DOWNLOADS ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
ALL_OK=true
for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="${LOCAL_DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$LOCAL/model.safetensors")
    echo "$ARCH pure: OK ($SIZE bytes)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "$ARCH pure: MISSING" | tee -a "$LOG"
    ALL_OK=false
  fi
done

if [ "$ALL_OK" = false ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Some downloads failed, aborting eval" | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# ---- EVALUATE ----
echo "=== PURE EVAL START $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"

for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="${LOCAL_DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  OUTDIR="$RESULTS/${ARCH}_pure"
  
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$LOCAL,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size auto \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path "$OUTDIR/" 2>&1 | tail -20 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

echo "=== ALL PURE DOWNLOAD+EVAL DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_download_eval_pure.sh

#!/bin/bash

REPOS[DeltaNet]="340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"

    if [ "$SIZE" -gt 100000000 ]; then
      echo "$ARCH: already exists ($SIZE bytes), skip" | tee -a "$LOG"

  fi
  
  mkdir -p "$LOCAL"
  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH ($REPO_NAME) START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
